name_en: Godel's relative consistency theorem for GCH
literal_source_claim: ZF+GCH is consistent relative to ZF.
canonical_claim: Provisional only: if ZF has a model, then ZF together with GCH has a model, via the constructible inner universe L.
domain_and_universes: Open: select a first-order language and axiom theories for ZF and GCH, a set/model encoding, universe levels, and the internal/external model semantics.
hypotheses: Provisional semantic premise: a model of the selected ZF theory exists.
conclusion: Provisional semantic conclusion: a model of the selected union of ZF and GCH exists.
excluded_degenerate_cases: The statement freeze must distinguish semantic satisfiability from syntactic consistency and handle model nonemptiness, standard versus nonstandard models, universes, and any required set-sized coding of syntax.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical logic, choice, quotient, completeness, and model-existence policies are not frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No computation, oracle, experiment, or unchecked certificate is credited; the intended proof is noncomputable and model-theoretic
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source selection, consistency semantics, ZF/GCH axiomatization, model encoding, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, assurance profile, or validator change; review due date and independent reviewers remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. Pinned encoding ingredients elaborate, but no exact source theorem, ZF/GCH theory, constructible-universe construction, or canonical Lean target is selected. No H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
